scope: Sony A6000 FW 3.21; static local analysis only; no firmware execution, binary modification, camera interaction or flashing.
method: static contrast against S19-04 and S19-05

findings.finding: The mode byte at sequence+0x50 is dynamically obtained through holder virtual selector 1 and helper 0x14011c; enum names are not recovered.
sub mode,2 followed by unsigned compare <=3 accepts exactly effective values 2, 3, 4 and 5.
Modes 2, 4 and 5 reach the common mode-not-3 error return; they do not build the 0x3900/0x0002 request.
Mode 3 alone builds ObjMsg(0x3900,0x0002), adds parameters 0x1000..0x1004, and invokes the interface stored at sequence+0x8.
Mode-3 operation is distinct from the known PbCap SDF path because its command id is 0x0002 rather than 0x3000.
None of modes 2-5 is established as an EncodeStill/PbCap-capable producer in this path: no call to the 0x15ebfc PlayData publisher, and no PbCap DMM raster/SDS allocation.
Camera.out0 runtime execution, Camera identity as holder, YC contract, output buffer suitability, and shutter mechanical avoidance are not established.
